get.description:
Search/retrieve users based on the filter string parameter. Please be cautious if you are using organization token, search API will only return users of parent company if company is not provided in the filter criteria.

Results are returned in ascending order of userIds.

Note: We only support search by email, name, userName and singleSignOnId. Since filter attribute contains special characters like square brackets, clients need to encode the filter attribute value.

    
        For search by email with value as test@egencia.com, you need to pass encoded value in filter which will be :
        filter = emails%5Bvalue%20eq%20%22test%40egencia.com%22%5D
        which is the encoded value for filter = emails[value eq "test@egencia.com"]

parameters.description: SCIM compliant filter attribute to take query string. If you are using any external tool to make the API call, please make sure to encode the filter value.

Search Users By Company.description: Replace {companyId} by the egencia company Id you want to search.

Search Users By Email.description: Replace {email} by the email you want to search.

Search Users By Email and Company.description: Replace {email} by the email and {companyId} by the egencia company Id you want to search.

Search Users By Name.description: Replace {givenName} by the first name of the user and {familyName} by the last name of the user you want to search.

Search Users By Name and Company.description: Replace {givenName} by the first name of the user, {familyName} by the last name of the user and {companyId} by the egencia company Id you want to search.
Search Users By Name and Company.value: name[givenName eq "{givenName}" and familyName eq "{familyName}"] and urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:egencia:2.0:User[companyId eq "{companyId}"]

Search Users By No Filter.description: No need to pass anything in filter.

Search Users By Single Sign On Id.description: Replace {singleSignOnId} by the single sing on Id you want to search.

Search Users By Single Sign On Id and Co.description: Replace {singleSignOnId} by the single sign on Id and {companyId} by the egencia company Id you want to search.

Search Users By Username.description: Replace {userName} by the username you want to search.

Search Users By Username and Company.description: Replace {userName} by the username and {companyId} by the egencia company Id you want to search.

parameters.name: filter

parameters.description: Number of resources to be returned. Maximum supported value is 100
parameters.name: count

AddressSchema.description: The complex model containing contact address attributes of the user.

country.description: The value of the user address country. It should be 3 letters (alpha-3) or 2 letters (alpha-2) ISO country code of the address. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty. Version 1 of the APIs support 3 letter country code while version 2 supports 2 letter country code

locality.description: The locality of the contact address.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the address. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty.

region.description: The region or city of the contact address. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty.

streetAddress.description: The value of the street address or address line 1. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty.

AddressSchema.title: AddressSchema

AllApproversSchemaV2.description: Approver details for the user like level 1, level 2 approvers etc. Approver of a user must already exist and its unique id needs to be passed to associate that approver with a user. The Username (email value) or TUID (Egencia ID) to be set as the Approver of the user.

delegateApprovers.description: Delegate Approver details for the user. Delegate Approver of a user must already exist and its unique id needs to be passed to associate that as a delegate to a user with Approver role

level1Approvers.description: Level 1 approvers associated with the user.

level2Approvers.description: Level 2 approvers associated with the user.

AllApproversSchemaV2.title: ApproverSchemaV2

ApproverSchema.description: Approver details for the user like level 1, level 2 approvers etc. Approver of a user must already exist and its unique id needs to be passed to associate that approver with a user. The Username (email value) or TUID (Egencia ID) to be set as the Approver of the user.

delegateApprovers.description: Delegate Approver details for the user. Delegate Approver of a user must already exist and its unique id needs to be passed to associate that as a delegate to a user with Approver role

level1Approvers.description: Level 1 approvers associated with the user.

level2Approvers.description: Level 2 approvers associated with the user.

ApproverSchema.title: ApproverSchema

externalId.description: External id of the approver associated with the user.

id.description: User id of the approver associated with the user.

userName.description: Username of the approver associated with the user.

ApproverSchemaV2.title: ApproverSchemaV2

ArrangerSchema.description: The complex model containing arrangers of the user.

id.description: User id of the arranger associated with the user.

userName.description: Username of the arranger associated with the user.

ArrangerSchema.title: ArrangerSchema

ContactSchema.description: The complex model containing contact attributes of the user.

primary.description: Identifier flag to determine whether the contact is primary or not.

type.description: The type of contact e.g. home, work, mobile, etc.

value.description: The value of the contact in international format. The number should follow this pattern : +[country code]-[area code][phone number] eg. +44-1234512345, or +[country code][area code][phone number] eg. +441234512345.  Please follow this link to know more : https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-E.123-200102-I/en

ContactSchema.title: ContactSchema

CustomDataFieldSchema.description: Egencia reporting fields. A complex attribute containing custom data fields associated with the user.

name.description: The name of the custom data field definition. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty. By default, maximum supported characters is 50.

value.description: The value of the custom data field code which needs to be associated with the user. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty. If the custom data field is of LIST type, the value provided must match with value on Egencia website. By default, maximum supported characters is 30 for LIST type and 50 for FREE_FIELD.

CustomDataFieldSchema.title: CustomDataFieldSchema

DocumentSchema.description: The complex model containing user document details like passport, Id card, etc.

expirationDate.description: The expiration date of the document. (ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD)

issueCountry.description: The value of the document issue country. It should be 3 letters (alpha-3) or 2 letters (alpha-2) ISO country code of the document issuing country. Version 1 of the APIs support 3 letter country code while version 2 supports 2 letter country code

issueDate.description: The issuing date of the document. (ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD)

issueLocation.description: The name of the document issuing city.

type.description: The type code of the document e.g. passport, ID card, etc. Except China and Hong Kong, for rest of the countries we only support documents of type PAS, ID & DL. Please refer the Enumerations section for the values supported

value.description: The value of the document. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty.

DocumentSchema.title: DocumentSchema

EgenciaExtensionUserSchemaV2.description: The extended custom attributes specific to Egencia travel management system.

approvers.description: Approver details for the user like level 1, level 2 approvers etc. Approver of a user must already exist and its unique id needs to be passed to associate that approver with a user. The Username (email value) or TUID (Egencia ID) to be set as the Approver of the user.

arrangerGroups.description: The arranger groups to which the user is associated with. The user must have an arranger role to get associated to an arranger group.

arrangers.description: Arrangers for the user. Arranger of a user must already exist and its unique id needs to be passed to associate that arranger with a user

companyId.description: Egencia website unique ID. The organization Id or company Id associated with the user.

customDataFields.description: Egencia reporting fields. A complex attribute containing custom data fields associated with the user.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the user. (ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD)

documents.description: A complex attribute containing documents associated with the user.

loyaltyPrograms.description: A complex attribute containing details of loyalty programs associated with the user.

preferences.description: A complex attribute containing details of the user preferences.

serviceLevelIds.description: The service level details of the user.

singleSignOnId.description: The single sign-on id of the user. It is the SSO ID used for authentication. It will be username handled by Auth if not provided.

subscribedCompanyIds.description: The GPIDs, associated with the requested user's company, that are subscribed by the partner whose token is used. Populated only for partner tokens; it is null for customer tokens.

userAuthenticationMode.description: The case sensitive Authentication mode of the user. Values supported are LOGIN or SSO. It is mandatory if the company is SSO_OR_LOGIN.

EgenciaExtensionUserSchemaV2.title: EgenciaExtensionUserSchemaV2

EmailSchema.description: The complex model containing email details of the user.

primary.description: Identifier flag to determine whether the address is primary or not.

type.description: Type of email. Ex. WORK. Please refer the Enumerations section for the values supported.

value.description: The value of the email address. It needs to be in a standard format and cannot be empty.

EmailSchema.title: EmailSchema

EnterpriseUserSchema.description: The extended custom attributes specific to Egencia travel management system.

approvers.description: Approver details for the user like level 1, level 2 approvers etc. Approver of a user must already exist and its unique id needs to be passed to associate that approver with a user. The Username (email value) or TUID (Egencia ID) to be set as the Approver of the user.

arrangerGroups.description: The arranger groups to which the user is associated with. The user must have an arranger role to get associated to an arranger group.

arrangers.description: Arrangers for the user. Arranger of a user must already exist and its unique id needs to be passed to associate that arranger with a user

customDataFields.description: Egencia reporting fields. A complex attribute containing custom data fields associated with the user.

dateOfBirth.description: The date of birth of the user. (ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD)

documents.description: A complex attribute containing documents associated with the user.

employeeNumber.description: The employee number of the requested user. This field is only supported for EU point of sale.

loyaltyPrograms.description: A complex attribute containing details of loyalty programs associated with the user.

organization.description: Egencia website unique ID. The organization Id or company Id associated with the user. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty.

preferences.description: A complex attribute containing details of the user preferences.

serviceLevelIds.description: The service level details of the user.

singleSignOnId.description: The single sign-on id of the user. It is the SSO ID used for authentication. It will be username handled by Auth if not provided.

userAuthenticationMode.description: The case sensitive Authentication mode of the user. Values supported are LOGIN or SSO. It is mandatory if the company is SSO_OR_LOGIN.

EnterpriseUserSchema.title: EnterpriseUserSchema

employeeNumber.description: The employee number of the requested user. This field is only supported for EU point of sale.

GroupSchema.description: The complex model containing details of traveller group to which user is associated.

display.description: The displayable value of the group.

value.description: Egencia Traveler Group - the value of the group to which the user is associated. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty and must match with value on Egencia website.

GroupSchema.title: GroupSchema

LoyaltyProgramSchema.description: The complex model containing details of loyalty programs associated with the user.

class.description: The cabin class to which the loyalty program applies to. e.g. FIRST, SECOND. (applicable to Rail only)

code.description: The loyalty program code associated with the membership program.

issuingSupplierCode.description: The name of the supplier issuing the loyalty program. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty.

lob.description: The line of business type to which loyalty program is associated e.g. AIR, CAR, HOTEL, RAIL. Please refer the Enumerations section for the values supported.

name.description: The name of the loyalty membership program.  This field is mandatory and cannot be empty.

type.description: The type of loyalty program if any. Please refer the Enumerations section for the values supported.

validFrom.description: The date from which the loyalty program is valid. (ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD)

validTo.description: The date to which the loyalty program is valid. (ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD)

value.description: The value of the loyalty program or membership id. This field is mandatory except for UK RAIL loyalty programs and cannot be greater than 30 characters

LoyaltyProgramSchema.title: LoyaltyProgramSchema

MetaSchema.description: A complex attribute containing resource metadata.

location.description: The location of the user resource accessible by URI.

MetaSchema.title: MetaSchema

NameSchema.description: The complex model containing name attributes of the user.

familyName.description: The family or last name of the user. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty. Maximum supported characters is 40.

formatted.description: The formatted name of the user

givenName.description: The given or first name of the user. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty. Maximum supported characters is 40.

honorificPrefix.description: The honorific prefix(es) of the User, or title in most Western languages (e.g., "Ms". given the full name "Ms. Barbara Jane Jensen, III"). This field is mandatory except for companies located in US for which it's ignored. Please refer the Enumerations section for the values supported. You need to pass label in this field. This field is not supported in version 1 of user APIs.

middleName.description: The middle name of the user. Maximum supported characters is 40.

NameSchema.title: NameSchema

PreferenceSchema.description: The complex model containing details of the user preferences.

lob.description: The line of business type to which preference is associated e.g. AIR, CAR, HOTEL, RAIL. This field is mandatory and cannot be empty. Please refer the Enumerations section for the values supported.

mealType.description: The preferred meal type. (applicable to Air only)

preferredDepartureAirport.description: The IATA code of the preferred departure airport. (applicable to Air only)

seatDirection.description: The preferred seat direction e.g. Forward, Any, etc. (applicable to Rail only)

seatFreeOfCharge.description: The flag to specify if a seat free of charge is to be booked (applicable to Rail only).

seatRoom.description: The preferred seat room e.g. Upper, Lower, Any. (applicable to Rail only)

seatSolo.description: The flag to specify if a solo seat is preferred for first class (applicable to Rail only).

seatType.description: The preferred seat type e.g. Window, Aisle, etc.

smoking.description: The smoking room preference e.g. Smoking, Non-smoking, Any. (applicable to Hotel only).

specialRequest.description: Any special request. The value cannot be greater than 80 characters

PreferenceSchema.title: PreferenceSchema

RoleSchema.description: The complex model containing role details to which the user is associated.

display.description: The displayable value of the role.

primary.description: The flag to represent if a role is primary or not.

value.description: The value of the role associated with the user. Please refer the Enumerations section for the values supported.

RoleSchema.title: RoleSchema
